cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS completed_order_count FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line WHERE order_status = 'completed';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line WHERE order_status = 'completed';
SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f WHERE f.order_status = 'completed';
SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS "人民币毛利" FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f WHERE f.order_status = 'completed';

SELECT p.product_line, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS "人民币净销售额"
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line;

SELECT r.sales_region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region r
  ON f.sales_region_key = r.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_name;

SELECT c.customer_type, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS rmb_net_sales_amount
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_type;

SELECT dp.product_category, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS 人民币净销售额
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product AS dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY dp.product_category;

SELECT dp.technology_route, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS 人民币毛利
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY dp.technology_route;

SELECT c.customer_region, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS completed_order_count FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f JOIN mart_sales.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key WHERE f.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_region;

SELECT dp.product_line, SUM(f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS rmb_sales_cost
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY dp.product_line;

SELECT r.sales_region_name,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS 毛利率
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region r
  ON f.sales_region_key = r.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_name;

SELECT p.product_line, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS 已完成订单数
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p
  ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line;

SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS revenue
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date d
  ON f.completion_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31';

SELECT
  p.product_line,
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS gross_profit,
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS gross_margin
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p
  ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line;

SELECT
  p.product_line,
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS sales_amount_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date AS d
  ON f.completion_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product AS p
  ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY p.product_line;

SELECT r.sales_region_name,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS gross_profit_cny,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS gross_margin
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date d ON f.completion_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region r ON f.sales_region_key = r.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_name
ORDER BY r.sales_region_name;

SELECT
  p.product_line,
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS sales_amount,
  SUM(f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS sales_cost,
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) - SUM(f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS gross_profit,
  (SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) - SUM(f.sales_cost_amount_cny)) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS gross_margin
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product AS p
  ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line;
